title: Secret Santa
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this holiday episode, the office engages in Secret Santa gift exchanges, with Phyllis announcing she is Santa and Michael impersonating Santa and Jesus, leading to humorous interactions. The episode also features tensions around the company's sale and layoffs, as well as character interactions and office celebrations.
